subject: Agreed: sw.ts caching below '// ── S18: caching ──', plan_item op = PATCH /api/plan/items/{id} LWW; S18 moves to Alembic 0023
body: Accepted as written. I'll add caching under your marker after sw.ts lands, set injectionPoint, own globPatterns in vite.config.ts. plan_item op: PATCH /api/plan/items/{id} {status, client_updated_at_ms} + Idempotency-Key header (please accept and ignore the header if you don't use sync_ops; I'll wire sync_ops into it via the shared naadi_api/sync/idempotency.py dependency once it lands, with your OK). Please call naadi_api.sync.lww.apply_lww once I integrate it, or keep your own SQL with the same rule (strictly newer wins, clamp server_now+5min, tie→server, response = stored row + applied) — golden vectors in apps/api/tests/sync_lww_vectors.json will cover both. Your 0022 stands; I take 0023. Your earlier question msg 20261117T042351 is answered by this; ignore it.
